notes.title: v0.49.0 - Environment and Responsiveness Update
notes.content:
Happy holidays, friendly farmers - Version 0.49 is here

[h1]New Features[/h1]
-[b]New Terrain System[/b]. We've upgrade the soil under your shoes. This should solve the tearing and flickering some players have experienced, especially on high-resolution monitors and when playing with the camera zoomed out.
-[b]Dynamic Environment[/b] Trees, water levels, and more are now synchronized with the game clock.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
- Dealers you send to Seattle have had their payouts tweaked.
- We've added a variety of polish to make it more obvious which plant you're currently looking at or working on.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a bug that caused problems with the Tutorial.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[b]*These two issues may be related*[/b]
- Issues with contract payouts have been reported in previous builds. We're looking into it.
- Starting a game, then quitting back to the main menu just to start ANOTHER new game has been shown to create instabilities. Simply restart Cash Crop or continue a game in progress. 


We'll see you after Thanksgiving!

notes.title: v0.49.0 - Sneak Peak
notes.content:
While we close the loop on a few of the larger features under development for v0.49.0, we thought you might enjoy a sample of what's to come. Check out what's new in v0.48.5.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
-[b]Weather Update:[/b] Rain effects have been enabled. Uncovered plants will collect water, depending on how intense the storm is.
-[b]Weather Update:[/b]  Heat waves have been added as a random event.  Your plants will lose water faster over time when exposed to higher temperatures. Consider sprinklers and buckets if a heat wave strikes.
-[b]New: Waterproof Tarps:[/b] Place waterproof tarps to protect your plants from a stormy downpour. Plants under the tarp will receive less exposure to sunlight as well.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29599727/e19aa079ae18d5e77f6388650ae5edb8e30545b0.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
- Spider Mites have been re-balanced and re-released back into the game.  Beware, these creepy crawlies can spread from plant-to-plant by hitching a ride on your crew members and growing webs...gross!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a bug that caused Investigations to end before they should.

notes.title: Version 0.48 - Overgrown!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29599727/b66fb5e7f4a9ecd6715fe31ac46cac1e53c56673.png[/img]

Did you know that some strains of cannabis can grow as high as 16 feet (5 meters)? Imagine plants as tall as a house. Sound groovy? This update is for you.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
-[b]Overgrown![/b] Given the proper care and enough room, plants may become Overgrown. This growing technique encourages your crop to become very large, requiring significantly more water and nutrients before harvest, but yielding many times more bud. 

To maximize your chance of achieving wild growth, [b]plant four identical strains in a 2x2 pattern, leaving a buffer of at least one empty tile[/b] away from any other plants. As below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29599727/a03170672c251503d8c0333556a7578080210b62.png[/img]

Keep your plants healthy, stress free, and with a little luck they'll merge into a tree of inspirational proportions. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29599727/99f80c1e02552cbbff63aed47309771a25036eb3.png[/img]

Once overgrown, the buffer is no longer needed and you can safely lay new seeds around the base of the overgrown plant.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
-The ‘remove plant’ tool is fully functional once again. You can find it in the Seeds menu, in your Toolbar next to 'New Field'.
-Overgrown plants will receive a “!” at the end of their name, signifying their difference from the rest of your harvest. For example “Snicklefritz #1!”.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
- The Harvest view may become temporarily confused when overgrown plants die under varying circumstances. This has no gameplay effect.
- Overgrown plant's sprites may temporarily "pop". This has no gameplay effect.
- Starting a new game may fail if you attempt to start it immediately after having started a new game. While we work on the next patch, simply restart Cash Crop if you run into this problem.
-There is no tutorial for Overgrown planting yet.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 0.46 Irrigation AI, Spectator Mode, and Reputation
notes.content:
Oh boy, do we have a patch for you! While work continues on the Stores & Street Dealers content update, we got some other improvements ready for prime-time.  Read on for details...

 [h1]New Features[/h1]
- [b]Crew AI has been upgraded to use sprinklers.[/b]  Your quirky crew finally got the hang of juggling sprinklers on and off.  When plants need water, available crew members will prefer to use near-by sprinklers before resorting to hand watering. Crew will operate one sprinkler at a time, but will later be upgraded to operate more.
- [b]Spectator Mode/Farm View:[/b]  Ready to let your farm run itself? Use the new button in the upper righthand corner to go into Spectator Mode.  Doing so puts ALL crew under AI control and detaches your camera for tycoon style gameplay – freeing you to manage contracts, research, wholesale, and think about your farm as a whole.
- [b]Reputation:[/b]  Do you treat your clients and vendors well, or do you haggle for every penny you can get?  Your farm now has a Reputation score (0 – 100) which changes based on the Contract terms you demand.  Building a positive reputation rewards you with access to more, and better, contracts. While being disliked results in fewer people offering you work.  You can find this information in the Contracts menu. 
	

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
- Contractors respond in real-time while you negotiate terms, emoting complaints like “I’ll have to run this by my boss.” when terms are too aggressive and “I can’t believe this deal!” when you offer generous terms.
- Reputation and inventory indicators added to saved game files
- “Weeks remaining” of cash is now displayed on your cash balance tooltip.
- Adjusted the inventory panel for better visibility while the Contracts and other menus are open.
- Crew names and current AI duty is now displayed on their portrait’s tooltip.
- Savvy replanting: Crew now que up seeds to replant after they harvest, returning to replant after trimming is complete.
- Crew occasionally take spontaneous actions; topping off water or fertilizer levels, instead of taking breaks.
- Text message warning when your farm’s Heat climbs above 40.
- Text message notification when new Contracts are available.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed an exploit which let players MIN/MAX Contract negotiations for arbitrary profits.
- Fixed a bug which broke Matthias and Heady’s images on saved games. 

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
- The Field view will not resize to accommodate very large plots.
- The Field view may get confused when the DEA confiscates plants.

notes.title: Cash Crop Update! Version 0.25.3 Is Live
notes.content:
The feedback we’ve received this week has been invaluable.  We re-worked the economy, removed some frustration points you guys identified, as well as adding a wholesale marketplace and fixing a handful of nefarious bugs.  

Read on for patch notes and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/662910/discussions/1/2579854400745388992/]please direct bug reports and feedback here[/url].

[b]Cheers![/b]

[h1]New Features/Updates[/h1]
- Wholesale Marketplace! Got some leftover Snicklefritz hanging around? Plies of Purple Urkle? Now you can sell bud on the open market! Hire the marketer to access the wholesale marketplace.  Access the marketplace by clicking on your bud inventory icon (bottom left-hand corner of your screen).

[h1]Quality of Life Changes[/h1]
- Colas no longer need to be manually harvested. They will be scooped up along with loose buds after you harvest your plants.
- Rebalancing harvest to favor more bud and less colas. Instead of needing to harvest a bunch of colas, it has been reworked to be mostly the bud pickups and colas will be a rare spawn that contains bonus bud.
- Each plant’s needs have been rebalanced to make them easier, especially in the early game - as well as more distinct from the other strains.
- The cost to hire the Agronomist and Manager have been significantly reduced.
- Reoccurring costs (farm lease, field upkeep, worker payroll) have been set to $0. Some players were able to reach unwinnable states. We’ll readdress reoccurring costs later when the economy is more developed.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-	Contract spawning bug! We have located another set of edge cases that cause contracts to not spawn after loading a saved game.
-	Contract reward bug! We have located another set of edge cases that cause contracts to not properly complete when finishing an any strain contract.
-	Fixed a bug where you would be unable to quit to main menu on game over screens.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
-	Hash-E contract does not appear during the tutorial. You can continue playing through.
-	Sprinklers may occasionally conflict with plants, when they occupy the same tile.

notes.title: Version 0.24.3 Is Live
notes.content:
It's been an exciting week for the team! We've been busy implementing the bug fixes and suggestions we've heard from you.  Thanks again for your patience and all of your bug reports; you've kept Blaggarth extremely busy and we have a lot to show for it!

Words don't describe how excited we are to be making this game with you.  Read on for patch notes and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/662910/discussions/1/1471967615874234931/]please direct bug reports and feedback here[/url].

[b]See you on the farm![/b]

[h1]New Features/Updates[/h1]
- Delete button for saves.
- Pickup range increased to unlimited. (It was unclear when you were in-range or not)
- Improved Tutorial.
- Option to skip the tutorial on new saves.
- Replaced buggy bud inventory with new improved inventory.
[b][u]Bankrupt Game Over[/u][/b]
- HashE will warn you when you can't meet the bills for the week.
- If you end the week with less that $0 and HashE has warned you then the game will end.
Crew
- 3 more crew members are available to help out on the farm.
- The crew menu has been removed for now. We will add it back in when we add the advanced crew feature.
[b][u]Staff Menu[/u][/b]
The Lawyer has a few new things to unlock! 
- A part time paralegal to help manage contracts.
- Some new fine print that you can add to contracts.
[b][u]Options Menu[/u][/b]
- You can now copy the save file location to the clipboard.
- You can control which music tracks are playing.
[b][u]Contracts Menu[/u][/b]
- Added a tooltip to the due date.
- Added an indicator when fine print is active.
- Fixed bug related to overdue contracts still being available to accept.
- Some code cleanup that helps with performance on lower end machines.
- Contracts now order more intelligently. Accepted -> Available Contracts -> Failed and Completed.
- Contracts now better indicate what strains it requires and how many you have available. (Several new hover tooltips)
- Contract negotiation has been cleaned up and clarified. (Checkout the new hover tooltips when negotiating)
- Added a fix for some edge cases that were causing contracts to not complete properly.
[b][u]Harvest Menu[/u][/b]
- Plants now show time remaining to harvest.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Contracts rebalanced to be easier when starting out.
- Picking up objects should now be more consistent.
- Fixing contract payout bug
- Fixed a bug where dialogue in menus would get stuck.
[b][u]Quality of Life Changes[/u][/b]
- Confirmation message on successful game save.
- Bankrupt game over condition reworked. See below.
- Colas now have a countdown when you break them into bud.
- More detailed information on save/game version to help us track down bugs that people are having.
- Smarter AI pathfinding. HashE gave the crew the ability to teleport if they get stuck for too long.
